I have restored the `channel` field on both the `OrderPlaced` domain event and the `Order` model, as well as the unit test expectation:

- [`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts): Restored `channel: Channel` on `OrderPlaced` and in `orderPlaced()`.
- [`src/core/order.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/src/core/order.ts): Restored `channel: Channel` on `Order` and in `createOrder()`.
- [`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/test/app.test.ts): Restored `channel: "web"` on the asserted `OrderPlaced` event.
